coupon_redemptions_target.name: coupon_redemptions_target
coupon_redemptions_target.value: "coupon_redemptions"."ledger_transaction_id" is not null or "coupon_redemptions"."order_id" is not null

order_legal_documents_filled.name: order_legal_documents_filled
order_legal_documents_filled.value: length("order_legal_documents"."filled_text") > 0 and position('{{' in "order_legal_documents"."filled_text") = 0 and position('[DOĞRULANACAK' in "order_legal_documents"."filled_text") = 0

payments_owner.name: payments_owner
payments_owner.value: "payments"."order_id" is not null or "payments"."subscription_id" is not null

refund_request_items_resolution.name: refund_request_items_resolution
refund_request_items_resolution.value: ("refund_request_items"."resolved_by" is null and "refund_request_items"."resolved_at" is null and "refund_request_items"."resolution_reason" is null) or ("refund_request_items"."resolved_by" is not null and "refund_request_items"."resolved_at" is not null and "refund_request_items"."resolution_reason" is not null and length(trim("refund_request_items"."resolution_reason")) between 10 and 2000)

refund_requests_decision.name: refund_requests_decision
refund_requests_decision.value: ("refund_requests"."decision_reason" is null and "refund_requests"."decision_key" is null and "refund_requests"."decision_hash" is null) or ("refund_requests"."decision_reason" is not null and "refund_requests"."decision_key" is not null and "refund_requests"."decision_hash" is not null and "refund_requests"."decided_by" is not null and "refund_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "refund_requests"."status" in ('onaylandi','reddedildi','tamamlandi') and length(trim("refund_requests"."decision_reason")) between 10 and 2000 and length("refund_requests"."decision_key") between 1 and 200 and "refund_requests"."decision_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

push_subscriptions_channel_env.name: push_subscriptions_channel_env
push_subscriptions_channel_env.value: ("push_subscriptions"."channel" = 'web_push' and "push_subscriptions"."environment" is null) or ("push_subscriptions"."channel" = 'apns' and "push_subscriptions"."environment" is not null and "push_subscriptions"."environment" in ('production', 'sandbox'))

takedown_requests_record_target.name: takedown_requests_record_target
takedown_requests_record_target.value: ("takedown_requests"."target_type" = 'record') = ("takedown_requests"."record_id" is not null) and ("takedown_requests"."record_id" is null or "takedown_requests"."record_id" = "takedown_requests"."target_id")
